note: Succession Matrix phases, gates and weights, version 0.x (unevaluated). The five phases are the venture phases of EE-012. Discovery has no weights: no product is ranked before the core product exists. Weights: 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high. Spillover is computed from flows_to, not asked. Changing a weight never needs re-scoring. Sources: packages/naive/src/records/layers/purpose/references/references.json.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.question: Does a real problem exist, and who has it?

phases.name: Validation
phases.question: Will people adopt this solution and keep using it?
phases.binding_constraint: proof that a niche wants the thing badly, and keeps using it

phases.name: Beachhead
phases.question: Can we win one segment repeatably, at a profitable cost?

phases.name: Scale
phases.question: How fast can we take the mass market?

phases.name: Platform
phases.question: What will others build on, so the venture can't be displaced?
phases.binding_constraint: becoming what others build on before the core goes stale
